name: Graphics engine exception
meaning: a GPU program hit an illegal instruction or memory access
action: Usually an application bug: check the job's own log and restart it. If it happens across different jobs, run the GPU diagnostics.

name: GPU memory page fault
meaning: a program touched GPU memory it had no mapping for
action: Restart the container that was running. If it repeats with the same image, update the driver or the image.

name: GPU stopped processing
meaning: the driver stopped one program's work after it faulted; the GPU itself is fine
action: Restart the affected job; nothing else needs doing.

name: Preemptive cleanup
meaning: the driver ended a GPU context because its process was killed or crashed
action: Look for the process that exited just before (an OOM kill or a crash).

name: Double-bit ECC error
meaning: an uncorrectable GPU memory error
action: Restart the node so the page is retired. If it comes back, contact the vendor about a replacement.

name: Micro-controller breakpoint
meaning: a GPU firmware micro-controller hit a breakpoint
action: Restart the node if the GPU stops responding, and update the driver.

name: Micro-controller halt
meaning: a GPU firmware micro-controller halted
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, update the driver and firmware.

name: Memory page retired
meaning: the GPU recorded a memory page or row for retirement
action: Restart the node when convenient so the retirement takes effect.

name: Memory retirement failed
meaning: the GPU couldn't record a failing memory page or row
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, contact the vendor about a replacement.

name: Video decoder exception
meaning: the video decode engine faulted
action: Restart the job using video decode; update the driver if it repeats.

name: Graphics engine class error
meaning: the graphics engine rejected a command
action: Usually an application or driver bug: restart the job and update the driver if it repeats.

name: NVLink error
meaning: a GPU interconnect link reported an error
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, check the hardware with the vendor's diagnostics.

name: GPU fallen off the bus
meaning: the GPU stopped answering on PCIe
action: Restart the node. If it happens again, check power and cooling, then contact the vendor.

name: High single-bit ECC rate
meaning: the GPU is correcting memory errors unusually often
action: Keep an eye on it; plan a restart, and contact the vendor if double-bit errors follow.

name: Contained memory error
meaning: an uncorrectable memory error stopped the program that hit it
action: Restart the affected application; restart the node when convenient so the page is retired.

name: Uncontained memory error
meaning: an uncorrectable memory error the GPU couldn't contain
action: Restart the node now: every program on the GPU is affected.

name: Context switch timeout
meaning: the GPU didn't switch between programs in time
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, update the driver.

name: GSP timeout
meaning: the GPU System Processor stopped answering the driver
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, update the driver and firmware.

name: GSP error
meaning: the GPU System Processor reported an error
action: Restart the node. If it repeats, update the driver and firmware.

name: GPU recovery required
meaning: the driver says the GPU needs a reset or a restart to recover
action: Restart the node; the GPU won't take new work until then.
